performance.name: Granular Capture Effect Demo
performance.description: 64-second demo at 120 BPM, D minor. EBM DW — Dark PWM Pad through an up/down two-octave eighth-note arpeggiator. Granular Capture is a serial Master insert. Every four bars: dry reference; stutter bursts; freeze/release; freeze with recapture; live granular; frozen grains with recapture; combined gestures; dry reprise and decay. Four step-mode controller lanes target channel 16: CC20 Stutter, CC21 Freeze, CC22 Capture, CC23 Granular. 127 on / 0 off, Capture rearmed by 0, all Reset Values 0. Slice 125 ms, grains 65 ms / 32 Hz / +7 semitones. Finite Arrangement, Repeat and Loop off. Final two bars have no notes.

patch_definitions.name: EBM DW — Dark PWM Pad
patch_definitions.description: Shadowy triangle/pulse pad with slow PWM and filter movement, chorus and restrained reverb. Suggested MIDI 43–79. Velocity-sensitive; settings apply to new notes. Motion rates are Hz; echoes are fixed time. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: Granular Capture
patch_definitions.description: Stereo stutter/freeze and granular playback. MIDI channel 16: CC20 Stutter, CC21 Freeze, CC22 Capture, CC23 Granular. Switches use 0=off and 127=on. Capture needs a 0 between triggers. All switches off passes dry. Reset all four CCs to 0 on sequencer stop. Freeze holds audio indefinitely until released; rack restart clears the buffer. Restart the rack after changing performance controllers.

patch_definitions.name: Stereo Chorus
patch_definitions.description: Continuous stereo chorus with twelve audio-rate sine LFOs. Amount (0.001–0.1 s, default 0.02) controls every LFO amplitude; each tap uses base + Amount + LFO, keeping delays between 14 and 230.5 ms inside a 250 ms buffer. LFO Frequency Multiplier (0.1–10, default 1). Wet taps share averaged stereo input and 8% normalized feedback; dry channels retain the existing 10% mix. Large Amount values produce longer modulated delays. Restart the rack after changing controls.

chorus_write::asig.expression: 0.5 * (left + right) + 0.08 * (left1 + left2 + left3 + left4 + left5 + left6 + right1 + right2 + right3 + right4 + right5 + right6) / 12

patch_definitions.name: Reverb Effect
patch_definitions.description: Stereo reverb effect, uses inleta channel names "left" and "right".
